description: A squat municipal box wedged onto the Meltwater Row verge, its frontage all scuffed institutional glass and a holo-shingle that reads WARD NINE · PERMITS · LICENCES · GRIEVANCES, the last word flickering like it's the honest one. A queue-line is painted on the crete outside, faded to a suggestion. A slot in the door is stuffed with forms nobody filed.
name: Office of Permitted Suffering
